original.description: Portrait of Leopold Graf Berchtold, described by the Bundesarchiv as "Leopold Graf Berchtold, österr. Staatsmann, 1922"; a cropped detail of the Bundesarchiv print.
original.photographer: not identified in the Bundesarchiv record ("Unknown")
original.date: 1922 (Bundesarchiv record) — eight years after the July Crisis
original.archive: Bundesarchiv (German Federal Archives), Bild 183-2004-1110-500, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 DE (Commons record: LicenseShortName "CC BY-SA 3.0 de"). Share-alike: derivatives, colorization included, are CC BY-SA 3.0 DE, and the Bundesarchiv credit string is mandatory.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: leave as it is — share-alike would follow a colorization, and a civilian portrait gains little from colour.

caption: Leopold Graf Berchtold, Austro-Hungarian foreign minister in July 1914, who drafted the note to Serbia. Photographed in 1922.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Dated 1922 by the archive; the caption says so rather than letting a July 1914 placement imply a July 1914 likeness.
